headline: Approved September 14th meeting minutes; discussed Whitney Avenue traffic calming and street light LED upgrades.
summary: Recognized the passing of former chair Larry Rosenthal. Discussion covered Whitney Avenue traffic calming and the 2019 Plan of Conservation & Development items. A street light LED upgrade was briefly reviewed.
decisions: Approved the September 14th meeting minutes; all were in favor.

decision_evidence.quote: PJ Deak motion to approve the minutes. Alison DeMaio seconded the motion. All were in favor.

plain_text:
TOWN OF HAMDEN, CONNECTICUT 
 
Energy Use & Climate Change 
Commission Minutes         
         
Regular Meeting 
 
7:00 PM, October 19, 2026 
 
 
 
Hamden Government 
Center 
2750 Dixwell Avenue 
Hamden, CT  06518 
Tel:  (203) 287-7070 
Fax:  (203) 287-7075 
 Click to View Agenda   
  
1. CALL TO ORDER 
  
 Brendan Smith called the meeting to order at 7:11PM.  
2. ADDITIONS TO THE AGENDA 
  
 Betsy Yagla motioned to add in the new finalized version of the agenda. PJ Deak seconded 
the motion. All were in favor. 
 
 
 
3. ATTENDANCE 
  
 Bredan Smith, PJ Deak, Betsy Yagla, Alison DeMaio 
4. Special Agenda Item: Recognize the passing of former EUCC Chair Larry Rosenthal 
  
 Brendan acknowledge Larry's service and dedication to Hamden and the EUCC. 
5. APPROVAL OF PREVIOUS MEETING MINUTES 
  
 
 
  a. September 14th  
  PJ Deak motion to approve the minutes. Alison DeMaio seconded the motion. All 
were in favor. 
6. PUBLIC COMMENT 
  
 No public comment received. 
7. CORRESPONDENCE 
There will be a brief summary of the correspondence submitted between the last 
correspondence update and this one. This includes but is not limited to any 
correspondence with council members that members wish to submit for the record. It can
also include written communication to the council from the administration, community 
members, etc.   
 No correspondence received. 
8. EXECUTIVE SESSION 
(if recommended by the town attorney)  
 No executive session needed. 
9. REPORTS 
  
 No reports given. 
10. OLD BUSINESS 
  
 
 
  a. Discuss EUCC agenda decision making framework:  
  
 
 
 
i. What is the goal of this Agenda item? 
ii. What information do we need to understand to map out the path to the 
goal? 
iii. Do we need to ask for approval/adoption by another Hamden Gov Entity? 
iv. Is the goal to make a recommendation to a town office or department? 
v. At what stage does the item need an EUCC vote to continue? 
 
       
  PJ proposed that this item reviewed in context to item "f" in the Plan of Conservation 
and Development. 
  b. Street Light LED Upgrade  
  Brendan briefly reviewed where the Commission left off with this item. 
  c. Traffic Calming on Whitney Ave - Restriping complete  
  The Commission discussed the bike safety, driver transition and future discussions 
with town engineer Stephen White on procedures for managing traffic pile-ups. 
  d. Term expirations — Submit a Commissioner Application: https://hamden-boards-and-
commissions.app.transform.civicplus.com/forms/35021 
 
 
Commissioner     Term 
David Cooper     7/31/2024 
Timothy L. McKee     7/31/2022 
Betsy Yagla     7/31/2026
Alison DeMaio     7/31/2026 
Lena Harms    6/30/25 
Ella Waller     6/30/26 
 
  No official updates on pending applications. 
  e. Solar and Fuel Cells on Town Property with “ACES UP”  
  
 
  f. Sustainable CT Project Categories: 
 
 
 
  
  
 
 
 
i. Tree Planting Program 
ii. Cool roof installation on a municipal or BOE building 
iii. Complete streets infrastructure build-out 
iv. Purchase an electric vehicle or electric bus for municipal use 
v. EV Charger purchase and/or installation 
vi. Energy benchmarking or energy planning 
vii. Energy efficiency projects in municipal or BOE buildings 
viii. Renewable energy or battery storage system installation in municipal/BOE 
buildings or properties 
ix. Municipal or BOE energy audit and/or implementation of municipal or BOE 
building energy audit recommendations 
x. Community energy campaign 
xi. Other (please describe the climate mitigation benefit of your project. 
Projects not included on our list will be approved on a case-by-case basis. 
 
       
  
 
  g. 2019 Plan of Conservation & Development (POCD) Framed Agenda Items  
  The Commission discussed the following five questions: 
i. What is the goal of this Agenda item? 
1. EUCC is specifically called out as the leader of sustainability efforts. 
1. 4.1: Items 1, 4, 5, 6 & 10 
2. Identify what has been done and what needs to be done. 
3. Mandated by the State and affects the town. 
4. State Planning and Zoning will review every 10 years. 
ii. What information do we need to understand to map out the path to the goal? 
iii. Do we need to ask for approval/adoption by another Hamden Gov Entity? 
1. Need to look at the six items and establish them as ongoing agenda 
items.
2. Meet with Hamden Planning and Zoning - Discuss schedule to 
complete by 2029. 
iv. Is the goal to make a recommendation to a town office or department? 
v. At what stage does the item need an EUCC vote to continue? 
 
11. NEW BUSINESS 
  
 
 
  a. Any New Commissioner Applications/Approvals? 
 
 
 
  
  No updates. 
  b. Summaries of other Board and Commission meetings  
  No updates. 
12. ADJOURNMENT 
  
 Betsy motioned to adjourn the meeting at 8:09PM. PJ seconded. All were in favor.
